name: LValueData.trivialLift_eq_stdClassSum_translate
summary: A class sum of a function invariant on both sides is unchanged by translating its argument (U(1) is commutative).

steps.claim: By the invariance of the kernel forms (`LValueData.kernelForm_invariant`) the class sum is unchanged under translation by g (`classSum_eq_relIndex_smul`, the relative index of the level in itself being 1, g commuting with the classes).
steps.lean:
(X.kernelForm <| · * g) := by rw [stdClassSum, classSum_eq_relIndex_smul le_rfl g _
  fun _ ↦ X.kernelForm_invariant.elim apply_doubleCoset_out _] <;> simp [trivialLift,
  SetLike.ext_iff, mul_comm' g]
